newsitem.title: UK: Burn Stewart says no merger talks with Grant.
newsitem.headline: Burn Stewart says no merger talks with Grant.

text.p: Scotch whisky distiller Burn Stewart Distillers Plc said on Wednesday it is not in talks with William Grant and Sons that might lead to a merger.

Responding to recent press speculation, Burn Stewart said in a statement: "There has been a trading relationship between the two companies which goes back for many years and this is expected to continue. Some months ago the possibility of a closer relationship was contemplated, but these talks were not taken any further."
